title: Free Relief from Temporary Water
question: When can you take free relief for temporary water on the course?

choices.text: You can see water on the ground under your feet or the ball when taking your stance
You notice water in a nearby ditch
It has rained at some point earlier that day
You hear squelching under your shoes

explanation: You must be able to see water physically under your feet or the ball when taking your stance for it to be temporary water. Just dampness, sound, or distant puddles aren't enough.
imagePrompt: A teenage girl golfer taking her stance over her ball on the fairway, with a puddle of water visible under her shoes and ball.
imageAlt: Teen girl golfer with water visible at her feet as she addresses the golf ball.

imageVerification.repairPrompt: No significant repair needed.
